title: INDOTALENT WHMS (Asp.Net-Core-Inventory-Order-Management-System) before 10.20261109 contains an authentication bypass…
description: INDOTALENT WHMS (Asp.Net-Core-Inventory-Order-Management-System) versions before 10.20261109 have an authentication bypass vulnerability due to a hard-coded JWT signing key, issuer, and audience in the appsettings.json file. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to forge tokens for any user ID and role trusted by the token validator, potentially granting administrator access to the entire API.
